name: sdd-loop
description: Agentic Spec-Driven Development loop: an SDD-outer / TDD-inner build loop driven from a stakeholder-validated PRD.md and a dev-validated ARCHITECTURE.md. Main-session orchestrator + bounded subagents (sdd-phase-opener, sdd-issue-worker) + deterministic hooks (SessionStart re-prime, PreCompact handoff, PreToolUse test-first). Project-agnostic; parametrized per repo by .sdd/profile.md.
